checks.note: Primary keyword should appear naturally in the title when provided.
Primary keyword should appear in the opening and body without stuffing.
Long-form drafts should use clear H2/H3 structure.
Meta description ideally 140–160 characters and keyword-aware.
Lead with a clear, direct answer when the query is question-shaped.
Include FAQ or explicit Q&A blocks for answer-engine capture.
Clear takeaways help generative engines cite and summarize accurately.
Avoid unverifiable ranking guarantees that hurt trust and citability.
